explication: Bitcoin Core is a full node that connects to the Bitcoin peer-to-peer network and downloads and fully validates blocks and transactions; it also includes a wallet and an optional graphical interface. The graph centers on that documented workflow and preserves major runtime areas visible in the tree, including RPC, mining, indexing, and cryptographic support. The README supports the principal workflow links; source excerpts and index references support the lower-level links. Other runtime connections are omitted where the supplied evidence does not establish them.
